summary: Iteration 7 — Full backend + frontend test of the 3 NEW features delivered this session: (a) GET /api/ai/preview_rec, (b) POST /api/import/trakt, (c) GET /api/calendar/ical, plus their UI surfaces (Dashboard UpsellPreview for Free + Settings Trakt import card + iCal export card). NEW backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_new_features.py → 17/17 PASS (100%) in 24.8s. Playwright E2E on the public preview URL verified ALL listed data-testid hooks render correctly for both Free + Pro paths AND the UI actually integrates with the new endpoints (Trakt upload returned '✓ 2 séries adicionadas de 2' and iCal download fired a real file with suggested_filename='seriestrack.ics'). Admin Pro state preserved; all TEST_* + upsell+* fixtures and any trakt-imported library docs cleaned up post-run. NO bugs found in the new scope.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: /api/ai/preview_rec uses TMDB-native /tv/{id}/recommendations (zero LLM cost) and iterates up to 5 most-recent library seeds — graceful degradation when first seed has no recs.
GOOD: /api/import/trakt handles all three Trakt export shapes (JSON list, JSON {shows:[]} wrapped, CSV) and falls back from year-scoped search to broad search when nothing returns.
GOOD: trakt import uses asyncio.Semaphore(8) to cap TMDB parallelism + hard-limits to 300 items per upload, preventing runaway requests.
GOOD: trakt import cap enforcement is correctly placed AFTER duplicate detection — duplicates do not consume cap slots (matches spec).
GOOD: /api/calendar/ical accepts BOTH Authorization header AND ?token= query — required for Google/Apple Calendar URL subscriptions which can't send custom headers.

GOOD: ICS body is RFC 5545 compliant: BEGIN:VCALENDAR, VERSION:2.0, PRODID, CALSCALE, DTSTART;VALUE=DATE: for all-day events, _ics_fold() handles 75-octet line folding, _ics_escape() escapes ',;\\\n'.
GOOD: 5MB upload limit on /import/trakt prevents memory exhaustion.
GOOD: UpsellPreview component returns null while loading OR when rec is null — silent no-op for empty-library users avoids a janky empty placeholder.

MINOR: /api/calendar/ical fetches every series in the user's library via TMDB even though only those with next_episode_to_air OR last_episode_to_air produce events — for large Free-cap libraries (~50) this is acceptable, but Pro users with 200+ items will see noticeable latency. Consider filtering items with status in ('watching','want') before TMDB lookup, or caching show metadata.

MINOR: ?token= JWT in the iCal URL is the SAME access token used for API auth — if a user shares the calendar URL by mistake, attacker gets full account access until the JWT expires. Suggest minting a separate long-lived 'calendar_feed' token scoped to GET /calendar/ical only, with a revoke endpoint.
MINOR: trakt import returns the first 50 not_found titles via `not_found[:50]` but `not_found_count` reflects the true total — UI should warn when count > 50.

MINOR: server.py is now 1985 lines — pre-existing concern from iter-6, getting worse with each sprint. Strongly suggest splitting into routers/ subpackage (auth, library, billing, pro, import, calendar) before further work.
